end.summary:
Aditya named spheres, cubes, cones and cylinders in toys and objects.
They identified flat and curved faces in cones and cylinders.
They compared cone and cylinder faces and applied shapes to a rocket design.
Aditya first changed a cone’s name when turned, then corrected this after Asha’s explanation.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming solid shapes and describing their flat and curved faces. Using examples such as a ball, dice, can, gas cylinder and rocket helped them explain their thinking. They mixed up a cone’s name when it was turned, but later corrected this and said it remained a cone. At home, ask them to find three objects and name their solid shape and faces.
